WATCHING · HOW THESE ARE COMPUTED

Watching rules

✕
Margin fadeFlags an active job once QuickBooks' actual costs coded to it (Customer:Job) reach 70% or more of its Jobber contract total. A job with no QuickBooks cost coding yet won't show up here -- that's a data gap, not a clean bill of health.
Unscheduled crewAny open job with no start date yet, whatever its status -- Jobber's own "unscheduled" status covers only some of them, so counting on that status alone hid work that was on nobody's calendar. Jobber doesn't sync crew assignment for these, so this isn't tied to a specific crew's open slot.
PC BridgeOnline = the freshest of the office heartbeat ping or the HiveLogic Monitor desktop agent's check-in (60s cadence) is under 2 minutes old. Offline after that.
Crew load, next 7 daysCounts real Jobber-synced visits scheduled in the next 7 days and how many distinct techs are assigned across them.
InspectionsReal Jobber visits in the next 7 days whose title contains the word "inspect".
Not connectedVendor insurance & certs, permits, change-order approval state, truck/equipment service, and loan payments have no real data source wired into HiveLogic yet -- shown honestly rather than guessed.
